    *   **Y-slices (Fixing Y):** For any $y_0 \in \{1, \dots, N\}$, let $S_Y(y_0)$ be the set of distinct colors in the plane $y=y_0$.
        $S_Y(y_0) = \{ C(x, z, y_0) \mid 1 \le x, z \le N \}$.

        $S_X(x_0) = \{ C(y, z, x_0) \mid 1 \le y, z \le N \}$.

If the set of unique color profiles (the sets $S_X(x_0)$) found by fixing $x$ is fixed, then the same collection of unique color profiles must also be generated when fixing $y$ or fixing $z$.
